title.id: Membangun Dark Mode yang Benar dengan Tailwind CSS
title.en: Building Dark Mode Properly with Tailwind CSS

excerpt.id: Strategi token warna CSS variables, class strategy vs data-attribute, dan trik menghindari flash putih saat halaman dimuat.
excerpt.en: Color-token strategy with CSS variables, class strategy vs data-attribute, and tricks to avoid the white flash on page load.

content.id:
Dark mode bukan sekadar membalik warna. Salah implementasi, hasilnya abu-abu kusam yang melelahkan mata. Ini resep yang saya pakai di situs ini.

## Langkah 1: Token Warna dengan CSS Variables

Jangan hardcode warna di mana-mana. Definisikan token di `:root`, lalu ganti nilainya saat mode gelap aktif:

```css
:root {
  --color-bg: 255 255 255;
  --color-text: 23 23 23;
}
.dark {
  --color-bg: 10 10 15;
  --color-text: 240 240 245;
}
```

Di Tailwind, daftarkan sebagai warna semantic:

```ts
colors: {
  bg: 'rgb(var(--color-bg) / <alpha-value>)',
  text: 'rgb(var(--color-text) / <alpha-value>)'
}
```

Sekarang `bg-bg text-text` otomatis ikut berubah — komponen tidak perlu tahu ada dark mode.

## Langkah 2: Simpan Preferensi

Tiga pilihan itu cukup: *terang*, *gelap*, *ikuti sistem*.

```js
const theme = useCookie('theme', { default: () => 'system' })
const isDark = computed(() =>
  theme.value === 'dark' ||
  (theme.value === 'system' && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches)
)
```

## Hindari FOUC (Flash of Unstyled Content)

Kesalahan klasik: halaman sempat putih sesaat sebelum JS jalan. Solusinya, inline script kecil **sebelum** CSS utama dievaluasi:

```html
<script>
  const t = localStorage.theme ?? 'system'
  if (t === 'dark' || (t === 'system' && matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches))
    document.documentElement.classList.add('dark')
</script>
```

> Prinsipnya: keputusan tema harus terjadi lebih dulu daripada render pertama, bukan setelahnya.

## Kontras Itu Raja

Beberapa angka praktis dari pengalaman saya:

1. Teks utama minimal rasio kontras **7:1** di mode gelap
2. Hindari hitam murni `#000` — pakai near-black seperti `#0A0A0F`
3. Border butuh lebih terang di dark mode (`white/10`) supaya kartu tetap terlihat

Dark mode yang baik malah membuat hierarki visual lebih jelas. Selamat mencoba!
content.en:
Dark mode is not just inverting colors. Get it wrong and you end up with dull gray that tires the eyes. Here's the recipe I use on this site.

## Step 1: Color Tokens with CSS Variables

Don't hardcode colors everywhere. Define tokens in `:root`, then swap their values when dark mode is active:

```css
:root {
  --color-bg: 255 255 255;
  --color-text: 23 23 23;
}
.dark {
  --color-bg: 10 10 15;
  --color-text: 240 240 245;
}
```

In Tailwind, register them as semantic colors:

```ts
colors: {
  bg: 'rgb(var(--color-bg) / <alpha-value>)',
  text: 'rgb(var(--color-text) / <alpha-value>)'
}
```

Now `bg-bg text-text` changes automatically — components never need to know dark mode exists.

## Step 2: Persist the Preference

Three choices are enough: *light*, *dark*, *follow system*.

```js
const theme = useCookie('theme', { default: () => 'system' })
const isDark = computed(() =>
  theme.value === 'dark' ||
  (theme.value === 'system' && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches)
)
```

## Avoid FOUC (Flash of Unstyled Content)

Classic mistake: the page flashes white for a moment before JS runs. The fix is a tiny inline script **before** the main CSS is evaluated:

```html
<script>
  const t = localStorage.theme ?? 'system'
  if (t === 'dark' || (t === 'system' && matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches))
    document.documentElement.classList.add('dark')
</script>
```

> The principle: the theme decision must happen before the first render, not after.

## Contrast Is King

A few practical numbers from my experience:

1. Primary text needs at least a **7:1** contrast ratio in dark mode
2. Avoid pure black `#000` — use near-black like `#0A0A0F`
3. Borders need to be lighter in dark mode (`white/10`) so cards stay visible

Good dark mode actually makes your visual hierarchy clearer. Happy building!
